implementation_notes: Existing plans upgrade with all/all visibility; new plans use all/none; normal and distributor existing renewals preserve PHP exceptions.
Legacy audience membership imports before users; current authenticated role is enforced on purchase.
Imported t, last_login_ip and online_count are separate historical metadata; anonymization removes it.
Only recognized bounded password formats are imported; imported digest and bcrypt credentials upgrade to Argon2id after successful authentication. Unknown/malformed hashes fail explicitly.
New traffic reset records snapshot reset_method. Older records without a snapshot retain the existing plan/system fallback; their original method cannot be reconstructed exactly.
This ledger closes the confirmed B01-B04 audit scope, not an exhaustive certification of every PHP business behavior.
Audience migration enforces a total cap of 1,000,000 membership rows, in addition to 5,000 per audience per plan, to bound memory.

existing_failure.reason: Test expects external background URL rejection, but baseline allows it. Reproduced from git archive of baseline_commit; unchanged by backend reconstruction.
existing_failure.not_fixed: Unrelated frontend configuration contract; preserve current frontend scope.
